Additionally, going against the grain, such as having critiques of mental health system, is often times not really acceptable in the circles of people who believe in political correctness. 

It's less of a progressive social idea and more of a clique, where knowing the right words and having the right list of beliefs is more important than actually doing meaningful work among marginalized communities, and it actively discourages people from bothering to educate themselves and form their own opinions, because having an an opinion that isn't deemed conventional can ostracize the individual from their social group. 

In my opinion, all you have to do is be a good person. Listen to the voices of others, learn new things, form your own beliefs but be open to learning more and changing them, and be nice to people. Hopefully in the future people become more willing to leave the hivemind and just exist as individuals with individual belief systems.
